info.name: Preservica - assets with an ARK (CSV)
info.description:
# Assets with an ARK, as a CSV

Lists every asset whose MODS identifier holds an ARK, with its Preservica reference, the ARK, and the other fields you choose, as a CSV. Nothing in Preservica is changed.

**Before you start:** on this collection's **Variables** tab:
- fill in `username` and `password` in the **Current value** column (current values stay on your computer);
- set `fields` to the other fields you want, separated by commas: any names from `indexed_fields.csv` in the Scripts repository (default `xip.title,mods.title,mods.dateCreated,xip.security_descriptor`);
- click **Save**.

## Steps

1. Click the collection's **⋯** menu > **Run collection**, keep requests 1 to 4 ticked, and click **Run**. (Sending 1 to 4 one at a time also works; send 3 again until the Console says *Done*.)
2. Open **4. Show the CSV** and its **Visualize** tab: the number of records found, a **Download CSV** button, the CSV in a box, and the first 200 rows as a table.

## The columns

| Column | What it holds |
|---|---|
| `preservica_reference` | The asset's reference (UUID) |
| `preservica_ref` | The same with its type, e.g. `IO_55ff719d-…`, as used in the ARK manifest |
| `record_type` | Asset (or Folder, if `recordTypes` includes `SO`) |
| `ark` | The ARK(s), as `ark:/32498/…`; several are separated by ` \| ` |
| `ark_url` | The ARK at the resolver (`resolver`, default `https://n2t.net`) |
| `top_level_folder` | The top-level folder the asset is in |
| `mods.identifier (all values)` | Every MODS identifier of the asset, ARK or not |
| then | Your `fields`, in order |

## Settings

- `naan`: only ARKs under this NAAN (default `32498`, Rod Library's). Leave blank for any NAAN.
- `identifierField`: the indexed field holding the ARK (default `mods.identifier`).
- `recordTypes`: `IO` for assets (default), `SO` for folders, `IO,SO` for both.
- `folderRefs`: folder references, separated by commas, to cover only those folders.

## How ARKs are found

Preservica's index keeps the values of MODS `<identifier>` but not its `type` attribute, so the collection keeps the records whose identifier contains an ARK: `ark:/32498/x7k9q`, `ark:32498/x7k9q` or a link such as `https://n2t.net/ark:/32498/x7k9q`. Records with only other identifiers are counted and left out. ARKs that appear in more than one record are listed on the report.

## If something goes wrong

Send **5. Debug: show raw responses** on its own. It shows how many records have a `mods.identifier`, a few of their identifier values as Preservica indexed them, and the MODS record of one asset (`debugAsset` picks which), so you can see where the ARK is. It shows no password or token.
